## Walkthrough Test-only update: the BareMetal skew enforcement test now uses a validated legacy qcow2 download URL (ends with `.qcow2.gz` and includes a 64-hex `sha256` query parameter) when patching the provisioning CR; the deferred cleanup clears `provisioningOSDownloadURL` and waits for skew enforcement mode to return to `None` before finishing. ## Changes **BareMetal Legacy Provisioning Patch Test** |Layer / File(s)|Summary| |---|---| |**Legacy provisioning patch and cleanup**
`test/extended-priv/mco_bootimages_skew.go`|The simulated legacy provisioning patch now sets `provisioningOSDownloadURL` to a `.qcow2.gz` URL that includes a `sha256=<64-hex>` query parameter (conforming to vprovisioning.kb.io validation). The deferred cleanup clears `provisioningOSDownloadURL` on the provisioning CR and waits for skew enforcement mode to return to `None`; the test still observes the mode flipping to `Manual` after applying the legacy patch.| 🎯 3 (Moderate) | ⏱️ ~20 minutes

MicroShift CI jobs automatically skip tests with apigroup tags for unavailable APIs. | | Single Node Openshift (Sno) Test Compatibility | ✅ Passed | New BareMetal test is protected by exutil.SkipOnSingleNodeTopology() in BeforeEach hook. Test operates only on cluster-level resources and contains no multi-node assumptions. | | Topology-Aware Scheduling Compatibility | ✅ Passed | PR modifies test-only code (test/extended-priv/mco_bootimages_skew.go). No process-level stdout writes or OTE binary entry points are introduced. >
>**- How to verify it**
>The baremetal e2es should now begin to pass, no additional QE is necessary. 
>
>
>
>
